nom: The Ordinary Ascorbyl Glucoside Solution 12%, Vitamin C Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive report a real split: several say this is the rare vitamin C that doesn't irritate them — including ones prone to breakouts, dermatitis, or perioral dermatitis who react badly to other vitamin C serums — while others report it triggered dermatitis, itchy or bumpy skin, or facial redness that only cleared once they stopped; one reviewer who says she is "normally not sensitive at all" also had a bad reaction, suggesting the irritation isn't confined to self-identified sensitive skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report good tolerance — no irritation, added glow, softer or plumper-looking skin — but a few describe dryness, tightness, or itchiness, including one long-time user whose skin reacted this way only after starting a new bottle she suspected was reformulated.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin are split: some say it does not break them out and even helps other breakouts heal faster, or that it keeps T-zone oil and hyperpigmentation in check, while others found it caused redness and irritation on the cheeks or was simply "too strong" and switched to a different product.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including ones who are also acne- or rosacea-prone, generally report it controls T-zone oil and clears breakouts without irritation, though one reviewer who did not test it herself speculates it may not suit oily skin as well as dry or sensitive skin.
segments.normal: The two reviewers who mention normal skin give mixed signals: one recommends the product for normal or oily skin types, while the other, who describes her skin as "normal to dry" and "not sensitive at all," still developed redness and irritation on her cheeks.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who names post-menopausal, combination skin in her 50s found the product too strong for her and switched to a different routine.

concerns.aging: The clearest report comes from a rosacea sufferer in her 30s who says the expression lines she used to have, particularly on her forehead, are gone since starting the product; another reviewer tentatively credits it with helping her wrinkles, alongside fading pigmentation.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, report no added dryness and sometimes more hydrated, plumper-looking skin; against this, a few describe the product making their skin dry, tight, or itchy — one whose skin only reacted this way after a new bottle she suspected was reformulated, and another whose tightness resolved within a day of stopping.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the product caused redness and irritation on the cheeks that resolved once they stopped using it, including one who was "normally not sensitive at all"; against this, one reviewer credits it with helping eliminate redness and evening her tone, and others with rosacea report it doesn't aggravate their redness.
concerns.barrier: Reports diverge sharply on dermatitis: one reviewer says the product triggered her dermatitis and left her skin itchy and bumpy, while another credits it with resolving months of what she thought was "incurable" dermatitis, and a third — normally unable to use vitamin C due to sensitivity and perioral dermatitis — says this is the only vitamin C her skin tolerates.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers who mention dark spots, hyperpigmentation, acne scars, or age spots report visible fading, in some cases within days to a few weeks, including several who call out results on stubborn post-acne marks or hand and arm age spots; against this, a minority report no change at all even after 6-7 months of consistent use, and one notes it did not help her under-eye dark circles specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts, including several who are cystic or hormonally acne-prone, report fewer or no breakouts, sometimes after an initial "purging" period, and a couple say it even helps other breakouts heal faster; against this, one reviewer developed small non-inflamed pimples in new areas within hours of use, and another noticed some bumps on her cheeks.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who tracks her own oil production specifically says the T-zone oil that came with her acne and hyperpigmentation is now controlled; another, without direct experience, speculates it may not work as well for oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Feels tacky or sticky right after applying
Can pill under makeup or other products
Leaves a temporary shine before moisturizing
Virtually no scent, unlike many vitamin C serums
More affordable than comparable vitamin C serums
Can leave marks on pillowcases overnight

extraits.titre: Not for sensitive and dry skin
extraits.texte: Not good for my skin as it triggered my dermatitis and also make my skin itchy and bumpy

I've been trying different products from The Ordinary to brighten and even out my skin tone. I'm in my 50s with combination sensitive skin. This product caused a lot of redness and irritation on my upper cheeks. I didn't get to use more than two weeks. I tried to skip a day, and then use sparingly, but gave up as I was having to cover redness that I never had before, and it immediately went away when I stopped this. Disappointing and a waste of money. If you have sensitive skin be careful.

I wasn't sure if I should give 5 or 4 stars because it took half of the product to see results, but be patient, you'll see results. I'm 32 years old and I suffer from rosacea. I don't usually write reviews because most of the products I've tried didn't give the results they promise, it was just mehhh. I used to go to bed having some expression lines, specially on my forehead, but since I'm using this product, I don't have ANY expression lines. I use a few drops in the morning and at night. It doesn't harm my skin affected by rosacea. Highly recommended for people in their 30s

extraits.titre: Works wonders on VERY acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I use this almost every night after experiencing a HORRIFIC month long breakout episode. I had very textured, discolored, acne prone (cystic & hormonal), oily skin and this product has helped with every issue. My acne scars have faded in the past 3 weeks of consistent use, and I havent had another breakout even during my cycle. This is an amazing gentle exfoliatiant if your skin isnt too sensitive or dry. I only use this once a day at nighttime combined with the Ordinary's skin barrier serum and salacylic acid serum for the daytime. Ive never found anything thats able to do what this product has done for my skin. With these 3 products, my skin has completely been renewed and I hope this never gets discontinued!

I have suffered from cystic acne since I was about 13 (I'm 27 now and still struggling…) but I swear that this has saved my skin. I have combination, sensitive skin and I almost exclusively break out on my chin. I had found a routine that was working ok but I'm also a healthcare worker so I spend all day in a mask, which has been incredibly detrimental to my progress on my skin. I started using this almost 3 months ago and at first I had some purging, but over the last month my skin has seriously transformed. I've hardly had any cystic breakouts even when I'm sweating under an N95 all day 😅 my scars and hyperpigmentation have faded and my skin is glowing. I use this every other day cause I don't wanna overdo it, but I can't recommend this product enough. Try it if my skin type resonates with you, especially at such a great price!

I've had issues with acne, oil in my t-zone, and hyperpigmentation for years. Once I started using this product, my skin has cleared up, my oil is controlled, and my dark spots have noticeably faded. I use this at night with Alpha Arbutin and Azelaic Acid. A little goes a long way - a couple of drops works wonders. I'm very happy with this product line.

I have been using this product for at least 2 years now. I have drier skin and have no irritation while using this product. However I do experience brightness, an overall glow and my skin just looks prettier/plumper literally the next day. Great product.
